stations.title: The struct
stations.text: Any line can write any number in minutes.

stations.title: Time card
stations.text: Only minutes that keep the rule get in.

captions: Kasimir finds a time card that says the cuckoo clock had minus 40 minutes at the bench.
The repair is a struct, so any line of the program can write any number into it.
You write a class that keeps its values private and changes them only by the bench's rule.
Now the card refuses the minus 40, and the cuckoo clock keeps its real time.
The repair guards its own values now. Next, it starts right from the moment it is made.
